name: Alerts
description:
These alerts map to section 3 ( monitoring) of CIS AWS Benchmarks Foundation. 
https://d0.awsstatic.com/whitepapers/compliance/AWS_CIS_Foundations_Benchmark.pdf

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* (*Trail or StartLogging or StopLogging)
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as ip_add
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user_name
| json "eventName"
| where (eventName matches "*Trail" or eventName matches "StartLogging" or eventName matches "StopLogging")
| count by eventName, user_name
| transpose row user_name column eventName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* ("StopConfigurationRecorder" or "DeleteDeliveryChannel" or "PutDeliveryChannel" or "PutConfigurationRecorder")
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as ip_add
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user_name
| json "eventName"
| where eventName matches "StopConfigurationRecorder" or eventName matches "DeleteDeliveryChannel" or eventName matches "PutDeliveryChannel" or eventName matches "PutConfigurationRecorder"
| count by eventName, user_name
| transpose row user_name column eventName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* (!Failure and "ConsoleLogin")
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json "eventName", "additionalEventData.MFAUsed" as eventName, MFAUsed nodrop
| json "userIdentity.userName", "responseElements.ConsoleLogin" as user_name, loginResult nodrop
| json "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| where loginResult<>"Failure"
| where eventName matches "ConsoleLogin"
| where mfaUsed<>"Yes"
| count by user_name
| sort by _count

children.name: Alert - Disabled or Scheduled Deletion of CMK

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* ("DisableKey" or "ScheduleKeyDeletion")
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user_name
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json "eventName"
| where eventName matches "DisableKey" or eventName matches "ScheduleKeyDeletion"
| count by eventName, user_name
| transpose row user_name column eventName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* ("ConsoleLogin" and "Failed authentication")
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json "eventName"
| json "errorMessage"
| json "responseElements.ConsoleLogin", "userIdentity.userName" as loginResult, user_name
| where (eventName matches "ConsoleLogin" and errorMessage matches "Failed authentication")
| count by user_name

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* ("CreateCustomerGateway" or "DeleteCustomerGateway" or "AttachInternetGateway" or "CreateInternetGateway" or "DeleteInternetGateway" or "DetachInternetGateway")
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as user_name
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json "eventName"
| where eventName matches "CreateCustomerGateway" or eventName matches "DeleteCustomerGateway" or eventName matches "AttachInternetGateway" or eventName matches "CreateInternetGateway" or eventName matches "DeleteInternetGateway" or eventName matches "DetachInternetGateway"
| count by eventName, user_name
| transpose row user_name column eventName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* (Put*Policy or Delete*Policy* or Attach*Policy or Detach*Policy or CreatePolicy*)
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as ip_add
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user_name
| json "eventName"
| where (eventName matches "Put*Policy" or eventName matches "Delete*Policy*" or eventName matches "Attach*Policy" or eventName matches "Detach*Policy" or eventName matches "CreatePolicy*")
| count by eventName, user_name
| transpose row user_name column eventName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* ("CreateNetworkAcl" or "CreateNetworkAclEntry" or "DeleteNetworkAcl" or "DeleteNetworkAclEntry" or "ReplaceNetworkAclEntry" or "ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation")
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as user_name
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json "eventName"
| where eventName matches "CreateNetworkAcl" or eventName matches "CreateNetworkAclEntry" or eventName matches "DeleteNetworkAcl" or eventName matches "DeleteNetworkAclEntry" or eventName matches  "ReplaceNetworkAclEntry" or eventName matches "ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation"
| count by eventName,user_name
| transpose row user_name column eventName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* "Root"
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "eventName"
| json "userIdentity.type" as loginType
| json "userIdentity.userName" as user_name
| where loginType="Root"
| count by user_name

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* ("CreateRoute" or "CreateRouteTable" or "ReplaceRoute" or "ReplaceRouteTableAssociation" or "DeleteRouteTable" or  "DeleteRoute" or "DisassociateRouteTable")
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as user_name
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json "eventName"
| where eventName matches "CreateRoute" or eventName matches "CreateRouteTable" or eventName matches "ReplaceRoute" or eventName matches "ReplaceRouteTableAssociation" or eventName matches "DeleteRouteTable" or eventName matches "DeleteRoute" or eventName matches "DisassociateRouteTable"
| count by eventName,user_name
| transpose row user_name column eventName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* (*BucketAcl or *BucketPolicy or *BucketCors or *BucketLifecycle)
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.userName" as user_name
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region 
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json "eventName"
| where eventName matches "*BucketAcl" or eventName matches "*BucketPolicy" or eventName matches "*BucketCors" or eventName matches "*BucketLifecycle"
| count by eventName,user_name
| transpose row user_name column eventName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* ("CreateSecurityGroup" or "DeleteSecurityGroup" or "RevokeSecurityGroupEgress" or "RevokeSecurityGroupIngress")
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as user_name
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json "eventName" 
| where eventName matches "CreateSecurityGroup" or eventName matches "DeleteSecurityGroup" or eventName matches "RevokeSecurityGroupEgress" or eventName matches "RevokeSecurityGroupIngress"
| count by eventName,user_name
| transpose row user_name column eventName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* ("AccessDenied" or "UnauthorizedOperation")
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json "errorCode" as error
| json field=_raw "eventName"
| json "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as user_name
| where error="AccessDenied" or error="UnauthorizedOperation"
| count by user_name, error 
| transpose row user_name column error

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* ("CreateVpc" or "DeleteVpc" or "ModifyVpcAttribute" or *VpcPeeringConnection or *tachClassicLink or *ableVpcClassic)
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName" as user_name
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.accountId" as acc_id
| json field=_raw "sourceIPAddress" as src_ip
| json field=_raw "awsRegion" as region
| json "eventName" 
| where eventName matches "CreateVpc" or eventName matches "DeleteVpc" or eventName matches "ModifyVpcAttribute" or eventName matches "*VpcPeeringConnection" or eventName matches "*tachClassicLink" or eventName matches "*ableVpcClassic"
| count by eventName,user_name
| transpose row user_name column eventName
